scope: Proposition 7.11 of the manuscript “Entropy equality and local symmetry in negative curvature” (preprints/Entropy-equality-and-local-symmetry-in-negative-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 339 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8658ab8209a8aa0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exists c0 > 0, independent of the fixed orders j, k, such that ∥Dj sGn,k∥ ≤ Cj,ke−c0kn (k ≥ 1, j ≥ 0) (7.7) on f−nD. Constants may depend on the initial patches and the frame Y . No bound uniform in j or k is asserted for the prefactors.
